title: Government office holdings (CM / DCM / Governor / PM / ...)
description:
Long-form consolidation of every government-office tenure across India, sub-national + national. One row per (office, person, period) triple. Carries Chief Minister seats plus source-validated constitutional national-office slices; DCM / Governor / Prime Minister / Finance Minister / Cabinet Secretary tenures land in the same file when curated. Compiled by backend/yen_gov/canonical/office_holdings_seed.py to datasets/governments/governments_office_holdings.parquet. Designed against Archigos (Goemans/Gleditsch/Chiozza 2009) -- the canonical political-science head-of-government event-grain table -- per Max review 2026-05-22.

Design decisions (Hans + Max + Fowler review 2026-05-22, see TODO/20260522-g1-cm-terms-retirement-handover.md; President/VP extension 2026-05-25):
  - office_id is the FK into entities.parquet[entity_type='office_bearer']. Role is encoded in office_id (IN-S22-CM, IN-PRES, IN-VPRES, IN-PM, IN-FM, ...) -- no separate role column. President's Rule rows carry the CM office_id with regime='presidents_rule' and person_name=NULL.
  - source_id is COMPUTED in the seed. Legacy CM rows may continue to omit citation_group_id and use office_citations, which derives Wikipedia 'List of Chief Ministers of <state>' source rows. New non-CM rows cite a first-class citation_groups entry aligned to sources.parquet and deriving source_id deterministically from (producer, title, vintage) per CLAUDE.md §12 v2.0.
  - `regime` describes governing condition and can be NULL for constitutional office tenures that are not a government regime. `selection_method` describes how the holder reaches office; `tenure_status` records substantive / acting / additional-charge semantics.
  - Per-term `references` is OPTIONAL inert payload that the current compile does NOT consume; preserved for a future office_holding_annotations.parquet uplift. Drops the publisher URLs the previous per-state cm_terms.json carried at file level.
  - person_slug is DERIVED in the seed from person_name; not stored here. dim_persons.parquet is the §0e.5 follow-up.

x-changelog.description: Initial schema. Replaces datasets/schemas/state_government.schema.json (retired in G.1.c PR alongside this file's introduction). 31 per-state cm_terms.json files were consolidated into datasets/taxonomy/office_holdings.json (359 CM holdings, 1947-2026) by tools/lift_cm_terms_to_office_holdings.py. Compiled Parquet (datasets/governments/governments_office_holdings.parquet) is byte-identical to the pre-G.1.c output per the SHA256 baseline in the G.1.c PR body.

Additive: add optional citation_groups aligned to sources.parquet for official non-CM office-tenure provenance; add optional holdings[].citation_group_id, holdings[].selection_method, and holdings[].tenure_status; broaden holdings[].regime to allow null for constitutional office tenures that are not government-regime intervals. Legacy office_citations remains valid for existing CM rows.

office_citations.description: Per-office citation metadata (today: the Wikipedia 'List of <role>s of <state>' URL used to populate sources.parquet.url_main). Keyed by office_id. The producer/title/vintage triple that derives source_id is recomposed in the seed from a per-role template -- this map only carries url_main because state-name -> URL templating is fragile (e.g. S19 Punjab requires a ',_India' disambiguation suffix). One entry per office_id present in holdings[]; the seed enforces 1:1.

citation_groups.description: Optional source groups aligned to datasets/taxonomy/sources.parquet v2.0. New non-CM holdings cite these by holdings[].citation_group_id so official Government of India sources can be citizen-facing provenance while TCPD remains seed/QA only.

holdings.description: Chronological list of all government-office holdings across all roles. Sorted by (office_id, start_date) on every compile.

office_id.description: FK into datasets/taxonomy/entities.parquet[entity_type='office_bearer'].entity_id. Grammar: IN-<state_code>-<role> (e.g. IN-S22-CM, IN-S22-DCM, IN-S22-GOV) for sub-national; IN-<role> (e.g. IN-PM, IN-FM, IN-CS) for national. Locked in Plan §0e.10.2-A.

start_date.description: First date of this holding (YYYY-MM-DD). Inclusive.

end_date.description: Last date of this holding (YYYY-MM-DD). Inclusive. Null for the current ongoing holding.

regime.description: Kind of government in power during this holding. `elected` is the normal CM case; `presidents_rule` / `governors_rule` capture central interventions where the seat is held by no person; `interim` covers caretaker / acting arrangements between elections. NULL is reserved for constitutional office tenures (e.g. President / Vice President) that are office holdings but not state-government regime intervals.

citation_group_id.description: Optional FK into top-level citation_groups. Required by the compiler for non-legacy rows that cannot use office_citations.

selection_method.description: How the office-holder reaches the office. Distinct from regime: Presidents and Vice Presidents use electoral_college, Chief Ministers usually use legislature_confidence, Governors use appointed_by_president when that batch lands.

tenure_status.description: Whether this holding is the substantive office-holder, an acting interval, or an additional-charge arrangement.

person_name.description: Verbatim publisher rendering of the person's name (e.g. 'M. Karunanidhi'). NULL for presidents_rule and governors_rule rows -- 'no person holds the office' is the honest signal; the renderer composes the 'President's Rule' caption from `regime`. Plan §0e.5 mandates verbatim text here; person_slug is derived in the seed.

party_eci_code.description: FK into datasets/taxonomy/parties.parquet.eci_code. NULL for non-elected regimes (presidents_rule, governors_rule, interim-without-affiliation).

alliance.description: Pre-poll or post-poll alliance the holding party belonged to during this term (e.g. 'AIADMK+INC', 'NDA', 'INDIA bloc', 'Secular Progressive Alliance'). Free-text per Hans Q7 -- enums flatten coalition nuance. NULL if non-aligned or not applicable.

notes.description: Optional context (succession crises, dismissal reasons, party-switch annotations, coalition collapses). The editorial-value column per Hans Q7 (non-negotiable to preserve on retirement).

references.description: Optional per-term citations the operator consulted to verify this row. NOT consumed by the seed today -- inert payload preserved for a future office_holding_annotations.parquet uplift (Hans Q2 + Max follow-up). Replaces per-term `references` from the retired state_government.schema.json.
